answer.reason: The Genesis verses tell several deeds of Judah himself, so a line of three clauses fits.

clauses.english: proposed selling Joseph to the Ishmeelites rather than killing him
clauses.quote: let us sell him to the Ishmeelites

clauses.english: acknowledged that Tamar had been more righteous than he
clauses.quote: She hath been more righteous than I

clauses.english: offered to be surety to Jacob for Benjamin's safe return
clauses.quote: I will be surety for him

doubts: Most verses marked from Numbers onward concern the tribe of Judah, its land, its cities or its people, or men of that tribe (Achan, Bezaleel, Caleb, Nahshon, Daniel); I left them out.
Jacob's words in Genesis 49 are a blessing pronounced, not an event, so I did not use them.
The birth of Judah and the genealogies only restate the summary.
